notes: H-3 source of truth; seeded into the `model` table by `python -m flame_api.seed`. sha256/size_bytes are null until measured on the target host (docs/hybrid-ai/PHASE_2_LOCAL_MODEL_REGISTRY.md, Pending table). status: approved = in use and evaluated; candidate = wired but not yet benchmarked (H-7).

models.name: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ

models.name: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5

models.name: cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2
models.notes: In use by default: FLAME_RERANKER_ENABLED defaults to true (config.py). The provider runs fastembed's ONNX export Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 (about 90 MB, same scores to three decimals), not the sentence-transformers class; model_id keeps its original prefix because it is a registry key. Compared only on the 26-question retrieval gold, without confidence intervals, so status stays candidate.

models.name: flame_cv
models.notes: Heuristic Otsu-contour pipeline with auto-adaptive preprocessing (v1.2.0, Princess, ported from branch Princess @ 1b32326), no weights. v1.1.0 is kept in cv/oldversion/. M10 evaluation: docs/cv/evaluation-report.md (draft).

models.name: flame_cv_video
models.notes: Resumable frame sampling, per-frame flame_cv analysis and temporal summary (Princess, E3). No weights; local only. Spec: docs/cv/video-ingestion.md, docs/cv/temporal-analysis.md.
